observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel machine with a blue sign reading 'DINGLI PACKING MACHINERY' on top. It has a hopper, control panel with digital displays, and is connected to a filtration system with three vertical filters mounted on the wall.
Photo 1 is a wider shot of the same machine, showing more of the surrounding area, including a second set of filters on the right wall and a window with bars.

Photo 2 shows a different machine with a blue sign reading 'WILSON PACKAGING MACHINERY'. It has a similar structure: stainless steel body, hopper, control panel with digital displays (showing '15.1' and '2.12'), and a yellow control box with red and green buttons. The brand 'WILSON' is also visible on the front panel. There are clear plastic sachets at the base, suggesting it is used for packaging.
The watermark 'SURE INDUSTRIAL MACHINERY' appears on all photos, indicating the seller or listing platform.
The machines appear to be vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) packaging machines, commonly used for sachet water production.
